title: Software Engineering Senior Manager
description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Software Engineering Senior Manager

 **In this role, you will:**

* Manage, coach, and develop a team or teams of experienced engineers and engineering managers in roles with moderate complexity and risk, responsible for building high quality capabilities with modern technology
* Ensure adherence to the Banking Platform Architecture, and meeting non\-functional requirements with each release
* Partner with, engage and influence architects and experienced engineers to incorporate Wells Fargo Technology technical strategies, while understanding next generation domain architecture and enable application migration paths to target architecture; for example cloud readiness, application modernization, data strategy
* Function as the technical representative for the product during cross\-team collaborative efforts and planning
* Identify and recommend opportunities for driving escalated resolution of technology roadblocks including code, build and deployment while also managing overall software development cycle and security standards
* Determine appropriate strategy and actions to act as an escalation partner for scrum masters and the teams to meet moderate to high risk deliverables and help remove impediments, obstacles, and friction while encouraging constant learning, experimentation, and continual improvement
* Build engineering skills side\-by\-side in the codebase, conduct peer reviews to evaluate quality and solution alignment to technical direction, and guide design, as needed
* Interpret, develop and ensure security, stability, and scalability within functions of technology with moderate complexity, as well as identify, manage and mitigate technology and enterprise risk
* Collaborate with, partner with and influence Product Managers/Product Owners to drive user satisfaction, influence technology requirements and priorities in the product roadmap, promote innovative and intelligent solutions, generate corporate value and articulate technical strategy while being a solid advocate of agile and DevOps practices
* Interact directly with third party vendors and technology service providers
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources to ensure commitments are met and align with strategic objectives in technology engineering
* Hire, build and guide a culture of talent development to have the skills required to effectively design and deliver innovative solutions for product areas and products to meet business objectives and strategy, as well as conduct performance management for engineers and managers

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 7\+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 3\+ years of management or leadership experience

**Desired Qualifications**

* Software Engineering experience, with 6\+ years leading DevOps – CI/CD areas and a proven track record of delivering multi hybrid cloud programs at an enterprise scale.
* 6\+ years of management experience leading engineering, DevOps, CI/CD, or platform delivery teams in a large\-scale technology environment.
* Proven ability to provide thought leadership, define strategy, and execute major initiatives that deliver robust, scalable, secure, and resilient engineering solutions.
* Strong experience across DevOps, CI/CD, SDLC, SRE, and next\-generation platform capabilities, including automation, orchestration, pipeline modernization, and industry\-leading vendor solutions.
* Demonstrated understanding of Agile delivery, release engineering, continuous integration, continuous delivery, site reliability practices, and enterprise\-grade software delivery controls.
* Hands\-on exposure to AI/ML and GenAI\-enabled software delivery, with the ability to identify practical opportunities to improve developer productivity, automation, quality, and remediation workflows.
* High\-level understanding of Infrastructure as Code practices, including Terraform, Ansible, GitOps, policy\-as\-code, reusable templates, and automated compliance guardrails.
* Ability to drive innovation across CI/CD product areas by simplifying developer experiences, improving platform adoption, and supporting continual service improvement for cloud and enterprise delivery services.
* Experience managing vendor relationships, influencing cross\-functional stakeholders, negotiating priorities, and driving outcomes in a complex matrixed environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical strategy, risks, decisions, and progress to engineering teams, partners, and senior leadership.
* Strong people leadership skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead with integrity, foster inclusion, build trust, and create an environment where team members feel valued, supported, and energized.
* Passion for hiring, developing, and retaining high\-performing diverse talent, while actively supporting career growth, coaching, succession planning, and team capability building.
* Curiosity to learn emerging technologies, self\-starting mindset, sound prioritization skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced enterprise environment.
* Preferred qualifications include cloud certification on Azure, GCP, or equivalent platforms; prior experience in banking or regulated industries; and experience delivering in a multi\-cultural, globally distributed organization

 **Job Expectations:**

* Should have cloud certification on Azure or GCP.
* Preferably prior management experience in Banking
* Ability to deliver \& engage with partners effectively in a multi\-cultural environment by demonstrating co\-ownership \& accountability in a matrix structure.
* Delivery focus and willingness to work in a fast\-paced, enterprise environment

30 Sep 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**


Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Specialist, Bid Centre of Excellence
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Title
  
  

Specialist, Bid Centre of Excellence
  
Reporting to
  
Assistant Manager, Bid Centre of Excellence
  
Key stakeholders
  
Head of Solution \& Proposals, Proposal Managers/Directors, Bid Coordinators, Sales Enablement and Operations Leads, Subject\-Matter\-Experts
  
Direct reports
  
Not applicable
  
Duties \& responsibilities
  
What this job involves –
  
* Work collaboratively with the Sales Leads and proposal manager to provide support for varied presales solution aspects, including bid\-response.
* Lead the kick\-off calls, coordinate with department heads to identify specific stakeholders for individual bids, and act as the main contact\-point for process execution.
* Manage the bid portals and provide regular updates to Bid Managers/Directors on projects in the pipeline.
* Complete first baseline draft RFP response, pulling baselines from proposal databases \& baselines libraries. Would need to edit or re\-write the responses to provide the best suited response. Gradually, start developing RFP’s end to end, while actively engaging with Sales Lead or Project Managers and/or Account Team.
* Own the development of tailored CVs/Bios/Case studies working with the business lines and SMEs.


o Engage with all organizational SMEs to ensure that their inputs are incorporated in a timely manner.
  
* Undertake research on customer and opportunity and gather competitive information to feed into bid\-evaluation process and responses.
* Contribute to the development of slides for bid presentations in PowerPoint, in coordination with the proposal manager, bid coordinator, and graphic design specialists.
* Assist in preparing qualification and client proposal materials by bringing the best of the practice and delivering high quality client development materials.
* Identify unique questions \& responses in completed bids, and update the baselines with new content or coordinate with KM colleagues to have this closed


Performance objectives
  
* Ability to understand company’s service lines, business dynamics, and value proposition, and showcase the same through accurate, comprehensive and well\-written draft responses
* Ability to share ideas, display proactiveness, ownership of individual tasks, contribute to team projects, and ensuring closure in strict timelines
* Teamwork, timeliness, quick learning, resourcefulness, ability to ideate – would be the key traits
* Should be open to support during peak hours or after\-office hours to contribute towards urgent client submissions


Key skills
  
* Experience in Proposal Management / Support from a reputed firm
* Content writing, content/knowledge management
* Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communications skills
* Proficient with MS Office (Word, PowerPoint and Excel)
* High attention to detail with consistent high\-quality deliverables
* Able to work on strict turnaround times, and have a problem\-solving approach
* Functional experience of MS Office (Word, PowerPoint and Excel); proficiency in formatting/design will be a plus
* Good to have:


o SharePoint – Creating lists/libraries/sites
  
o Experience in Real Estate industry, especially construction or project management
  
Employee specification
  
* Post\-Graduate, with excellent academic credentials
* 6\-8 years of relevant experience from a professional services firm, including proposal editing and writing


If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Program/Project Management Representativ
description:
**Project Role :** Program/Project Management Representativ  

**Project Role Description :** Deliver business and technology outcomes for assigned program, project, or contracted service. Leverage standard tools, methodologies and processes to deliver, monitor, and control service level agreements.
  

**Must have skills :** Program Project Management  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **7\.5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

The e\-Invoicing Project Manager is responsible for leading and driving strategic solutions and execution across the entire Consulting organization. This individual will help drive value through the delivery of the e\-invoicing service and software solutions to maximize revenue and profit margins. This role will lead and collaborate with the Practice Leadership teams, Product Management, Partner Enablement and directly with customers to execute upon unique value proposition of current solutions while continuing to innovate upon successes.
  

  

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
  

  

Ability to manage up to 10 projects simultaneously and provide guidance \& leadership to all e\-Invoicing project teams.
  

  

Responsible for project managing all aspects of multiple global, complex e\-Invoicing projects and strategic accounts.
  

  

Reviews implemented software solutions, documents lessons learned and recommend improvements where appropriate. Owns primary budget responsibility for the project(s).
  

  

Provide thought leadership on professional services best practices, frameworks, methodologies, and approaches to partnership with a 3rd party Alliance delivery teams to drive consistency into our implementations and improve customer experience.
  

  

Continuous learning by staying current on industry trends, country regulations and mandates, and best practices related to E\-invoicing and sharing insights with internal teams and clients.
  

  

Leverage existing subject matter expertise and build upon deep understanding of E\-invoicing standards and formats, including CTC (Continuous Transaction Controls), PEPPOL (Pan European Public Procurement On\-Line), EDI (Electronic Data Interchange), and country\-specific invoicing standards to develop, present, and defend rational conclusions, recommendations and implementation strategies.
  

  

Identifies opportunities for new business with existing clients and helps close new business.
  

  

OTHER KEY PROJECT MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES:
  

  

Makes decisions on scope and approach to deliver value to the client.
  

  

Participates in resolutions of critical and complex design and implementation issues across projects.
  

  

Demonstrates understanding of the impact of the range of software issues affecting consultant s area of specialization.
  

  

Provides work directions and leadership to assigned projects including scheduling, assignment of work, and review of project efforts.
  

  

Ensures that all project members understand their role, expected deliverables, and task completion dates.
  

  

Proactively resolves dependencies with other projects and activities.
  

  

Monitors project milestones, critical dates, and dependencies to identify potential issues that could jeopardize the project schedule.
  

  

Implements strategies to resolve schedule issues.
  

  

Keeps management aware of the major issues.
  

  

Assesses variances from the project plan, analyzes them, gathers metrics, and develops and implements changes as necessary to ensure that the project remains within specified scope (e.g. original SoW and all approved changes), budget (e.g. time and cost), and quality objectives.
  

  

Develops and enhances a productive working relationship with the client, project team members, partners, and other key entities.
  

  

Provides the project team constructive feedback as it pertains to project performance.
  

  

Leads efforts that extend and enhance the project management discipline.
  

  

Occasional travel may be required.
  

  

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:
  

  

Expert knowledge of product development, information systems, software development lifecycles, facilitation and influencing, and project management methods.
  

  

Expert ability to apply advanced project management methodology (e.g. Agile, Waterfall) and tools (e.g. MS Project, Smartsheet) to all projects.
  

  

Expert knowledge of project planning, execution, controlling, and closing.
  

  

Expert ability to estimate, plan, and track complex, technical, and dependent tasks.
  

  

Performs work without supervision. Handles highly complex issues and problems utilizing independent judgement.
  

  

Excellent interpersonal, organizational, time management, decision making, team building, presentation and oral and written communications skills.
  

  

Have strong problem solving, risk assessment and negotiation skills with experience in managing project dependencies.
  

  

Results oriented, customer focused, and exhibit good interpersonal skills.
  

  

Proficiency in Microsoft office packages.
  

  

EDUCATION AND TRAINING:
  

  

5\+ years of experience within E\-invoicing / EDI domain.
  

  

5\+ years of experience managing client teams within a professional services firm or equivalent experience.
  

  

5\+ years of Consulting or related leadership experience.
  

  

Functional and technical understanding of finance systems and processes (SAP/Oracle).
  

  

Strong operational management, project management, consulting, technology and process improvement skills.
  

  

In\-depth knowledge of E\-Invoicing regulations, technologies, tax compliance and financial processes, and best practices.
  

  

Professional PMP certification is preferred or equivalent combination of education and/or experience.


  

15 years full time education

title: Software Engineering Manager-Insights Application
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!


Our Values

**Best Life**


We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**


We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**


From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.


**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Lead and coach a team across backend, frontend, cloud, DevOps, production support, and release validation responsibilities.
* Provide hands\-on technical leadership for a production web application environment built around .NET / C\#, APIs, React / Redux, current Azure services, and modern CI/CD practices, while leading the team's cloud migration to AWS.
* Help define the next\-generation direction for the Insights application, including modernization, architecture, AWS target\-state design, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and developer productivity with AI\-assisted tooling such as Cursor.
* Own delivery execution across roadmap work, technical debt, operational improvements, incident response, release readiness, and production support.
* Partner closely with Product, Data Engineering, QA, DevOps, Support, and business stakeholders to translate priorities into clear technical plans, backlog decisions, acceptance criteria, and delivery outcomes.
* Improve engineering practices across code quality, review discipline, automated testing, observability, release management, incident learning, service\-level objectives, and responsible use of AI coding tools including Cursor.
* Support transition and long\-term ownership of complex or partner\-built application components into full\-time team accountability.
* Strengthen application reliability across multi\-tenant architecture, customer access models, background processing, messaging, integrations, and data platform dependencies.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Recent hands\-on experience designing, building, reviewing, and operating production web applications; this is not a people\-only management role.
* Strong technical background in .NET / C\#, API development, React or comparable SPA frameworks, and modern web application architecture.
* Experience leading engineering teams through delivery planning, technical decision\-making, production support, and release execution.
* Working knowledge of the current Azure production stack (App Service, Service Bus, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Blob Storage, Entra ID, or comparable services), plus hands\-on AWS experience to lead and execute the platform migration to AWS.
* Hands\-on AWS experience with production application workloads (for example EC2 / ECS / EKS / Lambda, RDS, S3, SQS / SNS, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, and AWS\-aligned CI/CD), including cloud migration or platform cutover experience.
* Practical experience with AI\-assisted software development, including Cursor (or a closely comparable AI coding assistant / IDE), and the ability to apply it to design, coding, code review, testing, documentation, and incident analysis while keeping humans accountable for production quality.
* Experience with CI/CD, release engineering, environment management, and migration or improvement of build and deployment workflows.
